command: --test-name-pattern=^draft autosave retains newer input arriving during an older database save$

settledAndLeave.text: return Object.freeze({refresh,dispatch,navigate,handle,helpers,getState:()=>clone(state),getRoot:()=>surface,settled:async()=>{await playback.settled();await service.settled?.();},requestLeave:()=>{if(playback.dirty()){playback.pause().catch(e=>toast(e.message,true));return {allowed:false,reason:'播放位置正在保存，请稍后再收起手机。'};}return busy||draftDirty?{allowed:false,reason:busy?'手机正在保存，请稍候。':'微博草稿正在保存，请稍候。'}:{allowed:true};},inspect:()=>({screen:ui.app,tab:ui.tab,bindingKey}),dispose});

testTiming.text: const f=await fixture({appId:'weibo',slow:true});await f.app.handle('nav',{app:'weibo',tab:'compose'});const field=f.input('[name="text"]','第一句');assert.equal(f.app.requestLeave().allowed,false);await wait(455);field.value='第一句，第二句';field.dispatchEvent(new f.win.Event('input',{bubbles:true}));await wait(650);await f.settle();

established: The existing isolated case passed once with no code/test changes, after both complete gates had ended.
Draft scheduling uses 450 ms timers; busy callbacks reschedule instead of joining a tracked promise.
stashDraft captures draftVersion and reschedules after a save when newer input arrived; the ordinary code keeps dirty state until that later save.
The public settled method awaits playback and service queues but not a scheduled draft timer or a later re-scheduled stashDraft.
The fixture fixed 650 ms delay plus settled is therefore not a deterministic proof that all draft work has finished.
not_established: The exact event ordering in either failed full run was not instrumented, so causation for those failures remains unverified.
One isolated pass does not prove an environment-only cause or rule out all product races.
No product loss of the newer input was demonstrated by this single follow-up run.
recommended_test_boundary: Wait with an explicit bounded timeout for public requestLeave().allowed, then retain the existing persisted text, same field node, current field text and leave-allowed assertions; fail visibly if the boundary never arrives.
modifications: No production or test source modified. Only requested diagnostic evidence written.
